descriptions.platformSessionReady: Set after the session gate step. Later steps can use it to run only after the app/account is ready.
descriptions.enableConnectionRequest: Safety gate for the friend-request step. Set false to scan/open profiles without sending a request.
descriptions.peopleProfileSelected: Result of selecting a profile from a people list. True means the flow selected a valid profile.
descriptions.authorProfileOpened: Result of opening the author profile from a keyword-matched post.
descriptions.commenterProfileOpened: Result of opening a commenter profile from a keyword-matched post.
descriptions.commentSheetOpened: True when the agent opened the comment sheet/list to collect commenters.
descriptions.candidateAvailable: Shows whether the source pool/candidate lease found the next target.
descriptions.candidateId: Internal id of the candidate lease held for the current run.
descriptions.candidateEntityId: External entity id behind the candidate being processed.
descriptions.candidateExternalId: Target id on the external platform, such as Facebook, when available.
descriptions.candidateName: Current target name written by the target selection/lease step for later steps.
descriptions.candidateUrl: Current target URL written by the target selection/lease step for later steps.
descriptions.candidateLeaseToken: Token used to confirm or release the candidate lease after processing.
descriptions.targetAvailable: True when the lease/source-pool step found a target for the current device.
descriptions.targetActionId: Target action id used by the backend to track processing state.
descriptions.targetEntityId: Source entity id assigned to the device or leased at run time.
descriptions.targetExternalId: External platform id used to reconcile crawled data.
descriptions.targetName: Target display name used for search, row matching, or logs.
descriptions.targetUrl: Canonical URL of the target when source data has one.
descriptions.targetSearchText: Normalized text the agent types into the target search field.
descriptions.targetSearchQuery: Search query from the target catalog/campaign target or locator.
descriptions.targetSelectorBy: Selector type used to identify the target row on device.
descriptions.targetSelectorValue: Primary selector value used to open the correct target on device.
descriptions.targetFallbackSelectorBy: Fallback selector type used when the primary selector does not match.
descriptions.targetFallbackSelectorValue: Fallback selector value used to open the target.
descriptions.targetGroupName: Group name for the target, usually when the target is a Facebook group.
descriptions.targetLocator: Full target locator object, including search query and selectors.
descriptions.groupCount: Number of groups the loop will run; usually created from the Targets tab.
descriptions.groupSearches: Search-query list for group targets, one item per group.
descriptions.groupRowTexts: Displayed row-text list used to verify the correct group was opened.
descriptions.groupSearchCurrent: Current group value selected from GROUP_SEARCHES by GROUP_INDEX.
descriptions.groupRowTextCurrent: Current group row text selected from GROUP_ROW_TEXTS by GROUP_INDEX.
descriptions.groupScanSeconds: Time the agent spends scanning/interacting inside a group.
descriptions.pageCount: Number of Pages the loop will run; usually created from the Targets tab.
descriptions.pageTargets: Page target list or Page names used by the loop.
descriptions.pageRowTexts: Page row-text list used to verify the correct Page was opened.
descriptions.pageSearchCurrent: Current Page value selected from PAGE_TARGETS by PAGE_INDEX.
descriptions.pageRowTextCurrent: Current Page row text selected from PAGE_ROW_TEXTS by PAGE_INDEX.
descriptions.commentText: Text used by comment or content interaction steps.
descriptions.commentInputLabel: UI label used to find the comment input field in the app.
descriptions.commentSubmitLabel: UI label used to find the comment submit button in the app.
descriptions.postKeywords: Keyword list used to decide which posts are eligible for interaction.
descriptions.postTargetCount: Number of post/candidate posts the agent tries to process in this run.
descriptions.postRunSeconds: Time limit for the current post scan/run loop.
descriptions.maxPages: Limits screens or scroll passes so scans do not run too long.
descriptions.pageKeywords: Keyword list used to crawl/search Facebook Pages.
descriptions.pageKeywordCount: Number of Page keywords to run, usually synced from PAGE_KEYWORDS.
descriptions.maxItemsPerKeyword: Maximum Page results saved per keyword.
descriptions.profileRequiredKeywords: The profile must contain these keywords to qualify.
descriptions.profileBonusKeywords: Keywords that increase confidence while evaluating a profile.
descriptions.profileOptionalKeywords: Bonus keywords for profile scoring; they are not required.
descriptions.profileBlockedKeywords: If the profile contains these keywords, the flow skips that target.
descriptions.profileForbiddenKeywords: If the profile contains these keywords, the flow skips that target.
descriptions.profileMinScore: Minimum score required for a profile to qualify after keyword scoring.
descriptions.postScanResult: Object result from the post scan step, including matched post, action/comment bounds, and context for opening the author or commenter.
descriptions.groupPostScanResult: Object result from scanning posts inside the current group.
descriptions.peopleTarget: Verified profile object used as input for the friend-request step.
descriptions.postTarget: Post object selected by a scan/selection step.
descriptions.visibleConnectionAction: Result of detecting a visible friend/message/follow action on screen.
descriptions.peopleConnectionAction: Result of performing the connection action for the selected profile.
descriptions.groupJoinAction: Result of joining or opening a group.
descriptions.deviceSerial: Serial of the device running the scenario.
descriptions.deviceModel: Model of the device running the scenario.
descriptions.randomInt: Random number from 1 to 100 generated when the variable is resolved.
descriptions.randomUuid: Fresh UUID generated when the variable is resolved.
descriptions.stepIndex: Current step index in the scenario.
descriptions.loopIndex: Current loop index, updated by loop/repeat nodes.
descriptions.accountId: Id of the account bound to the device/campaign.
descriptions.accountPassword: Password resolved by the backend at run time; do not store it as a manual variable.
descriptions.accountTotpCode: 2FA code generated from the account secret at run time.
descriptions.accountTotpSecret: 2FA secret from the account vault, used internally to generate codes.
descriptions.accountDisplayName: Display name of the bound account.
descriptions.genericAccount: Account variable resolved from the account bound to the device/campaign.
descriptions.genericBuiltin: Built-in system variable resolved automatically by the backend at run time.
descriptions.genericStepOutput: Output variable written by a previous node through save_as/data_var.
descriptions.genericGate: On/off gate configured by the user or campaign to control a branch.
descriptions.genericRuntimeState: Runtime state variable written by a previous node and read by condition nodes.
descriptions.genericProfileResult: Profile/candidate result variable written by a profile selection or verification step.
descriptions.genericProfileTarget: Profile target configuration variable, usually entered by the user/campaign before the run.
descriptions.genericLoopIndex: Index variable updated by a loop/repeat node on each iteration.
descriptions.genericTargetData: Target variable injected from campaign target/source pool or by a target lease step.
descriptions.genericGroupData: Group variable from the Targets tab, campaign target, or source pool.
descriptions.genericPageData: Page variable from the Targets tab, campaign target, or source pool.
descriptions.genericSearchTarget: Target search/row-text variable, usually configured by the user or campaign.
descriptions.genericContent: Content/keyword variable used by typing, filtering, or commenting steps.
descriptions.genericRunConfig: Run-count, timing, or limit configuration variable.
descriptions.genericCustom: Custom scenario/campaign variable. For clearer source hints, name it with GROUP_, PAGE_, TARGET_, PROFILE_, or create it through a node save_as.

origins.platformSessionReady: Written by the Platform session gate node at run time. It reads app/account readiness from the device session.
origins.enableConnectionRequest: Configured by the user or campaign before the run. The flow reads it in a condition node before sending a friend request.
origins.peopleProfileSelected: Written by the people profile selection/opening node after the agent checks whether the profile is valid.
origins.authorProfileOpened: Written by the Open author from matched post node after opening the author's profile on the device.
origins.commenterProfileOpened: Written by the Open commenter from matched post node after opening the commenter's profile on the device.
origins.commentSheetOpened: Written by the Open commenter from matched post node after opening the comment list.
origins.candidateLease: Written by the lease_connection_candidate node from the backend candidate pool assigned to the device.
origins.targetLease: Written by the lease_source_target node from the source pool/campaign target.
origins.targetAssignment: Injected by campaign dispatch or source pool from the target/catalog assigned to the device.
origins.groupTargets: Created from groups selected or entered in the Targets tab or campaign target setup.
origins.pageTargets: Created from Pages selected or entered in the Targets tab or campaign target setup.
origins.loopFromList: Written by a set_variable node that picks the current list item by loop index.
origins.manualOrCampaign: Entered in Scenario Variables or overridden by the campaign before the run.
origins.postScan: Written by a post scan node through save_as after it finds a matching post.
origins.peopleTarget: Written by a profile opening/verification node through save_as after the profile qualifies.
origins.connectionAction: Written by a connection-action node through save_as after it reads or performs the action.
origins.groupJoinAction: Written by a group join/open node through save_as.
origins.previousStepSaveAs: Written by a previous node through save_as/data_var/extract_var.
origins.previousStepRuntime: Written by a previous node as runtime state.
origins.systemBuiltin: Created or resolved automatically by the backend at run time.
origins.deviceRuntime: Read by the backend from the device running the scenario.
origins.stepRuntime: Updated by runtime for the current step.
origins.loopRuntime: Updated by loop/repeat nodes on each iteration.
origins.accountBinding: Injected by the campaign/device account binding before the run.
origins.accountSecret: Resolved from the account vault by the backend at run time; plaintext should not be stored in scenario variables.
origins.custom: Named by the user or template.

selector.classNameHint: Extra Android view class filter — usually leave as filled by pick.

extract.expandSeeMoreDescription: Tap “See more” and wait for UI to settle before parsing — recommended for long content.
extract.stopIfNoNewDescription: Stop after several rounds with no new items — saves time.
extract.advancedExpandHint: Only adjust if content is still truncated or runs are too slow. Most campaigns keep defaults.

extract.strategyVersionHint: Only v1 is supported for now.

extract.groupScrollPauseHint: Wait after each scroll so search results can load.
extract.commentScrollPassesHint: Total scroll passes inside the comment sheet.
extract.commentSwipesPerDumpHint: Dump hierarchy XML and parse more comments after every N swipes.
extract.commentScrollDistanceHint: Screen ratio used for each comment-sheet scroll.
extract.commentScrollDurationHint: Duration of each swipe in the comment sheet.
extract.commentScrollPauseHint: Wait time after each scroll so the UI can settle.

extract.commentEarlyStopNoNew: Stop when no new comments appear
extract.commentNoGrowthBreakHint: Stop after repeated dumps with no new comments.
extract.minCommentScanPassesHint: Always scan at least N rounds before early stop can apply.

extract.saveDetailsHint: Collection, tags, parent id — only for custom pipelines.

extract.saveParentLinkHint: Mainly for comments: attach each comment to the post on screen.
extract.saveAdvancedHint: Override platform, content type, labels, or parent link for custom pipelines.
extract.stopIfNoNewLabel: Stop early when no new data is found
